description:
About Our Brand and Products

We design simple, well-considered tools that make everyday cleaning easier to start — and easier to finish.

Our products are built around daily routines, not deep-cleaning sessions.
They’re meant to stay visible, accessible, and ready to use, so small actions don’t get delayed or forgotten.

We believe a tidy space doesn’t come from more discipline —
it comes from lower friction.

What Makes Us Different

Designed for daily use
Our products are meant to be used in seconds, right after use — not stored away and forgotten.

No installation, no setup friction
Easy to hang, easy to grab, easy to put back.

Minimal, intentional design
They fit naturally into modern bathrooms and living spaces.

Behavior-driven, not feature-stacked
We focus on helping people actually build habits, instead of adding unnecessary functions.

That’s why our products resonate with people who value:

  • Order and clarity

  • Efficient routines

  • Clean spaces without mental overload

Recognized by Design & Independent Reviews

Our approach to simplicity and usability has been recognized by both design institutions and independent reviewers.

  • Winner of the 2025 American Good Design Bronze Award

  • “Water, limescale, streaks — this shower squeegee removes everything.”
    — n-tv.de comparison test, 2025

  • “Our top pick for effortless daily shower cleaning — perfect as a thoughtful, practical gift.”
    — BestReviews Gift Guide, 2025

These recognitions reflect what users value most:
products that work quietly, reliably, and every day.

Why This Product Works for Any Audience

No matter what type of audience you serve —
home organization, lifestyle, apartments, cleaning, minimalism, or daily routines —
everyone needs a good squeegee.

It’s a universal, practical tool that solves a problem people already recognize:
water marks, glass buildup, and the friction of cleaning after a shower.

Because it’s simple, visual, and easy to understand, it performs well across:

  • Different content styles

  • Different audience sizes

  • Different platforms

You don’t need to educate people to create interest — the need is already there.

How Affiliates Can Earn

  • Earn commission for every confirmed order through your unique affiliate link

  • Cookie-based tracking ensures proper attribution

  • Commissions are paid for real purchases, not clicks or impressions

  • Long-term potential for higher commissions with consistent performance

Exact commission rates and payout terms are available inside the affiliate dashboard after approval.

How to Promote Us

We encourage authentic, content-first promotion, such as:

  • Real-life usage in daily routines

  • Bathroom, home, or apartment setup content

  • Before / after or habit-based storytelling

  • Blog posts or videos showing practical use cases

  • Honest reviews based on real experience

You are not required to use scripted messaging.
We value natural integration that makes sense for your audience.

Product Samples & Collaboration

If you genuinely resonate with our brand philosophy and way of thinking,
we’re open to deeper collaboration.

Approved affiliates and creators may contact us to:

  • Request product samples for content creation

  • Test the product before promoting it

  • Discuss long-term partnership opportunities

We value real experience and honest recommendations over volume-driven promotion.

If that aligns with how you work, we’d love to connect.

Other Information

  • All affiliate applications are reviewed manually

  • We prioritize creators and publishers whose content aligns with our values

  • Brand misuse, misleading claims, or unauthorized discounting may result in removal from the program

  • Our goal is to build long-term partnerships, not one-off promotions
payout_period: Commissions are eligible after a 30-day order confirmation period. Payouts are available once your balance reaches the $50 minimum. If not reached, commissions roll over to the next month.
